title: aeschynomene nicaraguensis
intro: Aeschynomene nicaraguensis, commonly known as the Nicaraguan horsefly tree or horsefly pea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Aeschynomene nicaraguensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its various health benefits.
